I only buy fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves. I'm not buying anything else! Especially NOT trolls, orcs or humans!

Tom the Tanner
Be polite and respectful to other people you meet. Most dangers are far easier to overcome for teams, so try to find some companions.
The inhabitants usually want to be addressed with a nice 'hello'. Ask them about their 'offers'. You can also ask them for their 'job', 'help' or a 'mission'.

Speak to the inhabitants of the isle to get help or trade with them. Don't leave the walls until you own at least a leather armor and a helmet, a wooden shield, and a short sword.
Don't leave the protection of the village too soon. First try to get better equipment. Buy equipment at a store. Sell spare food at the farm.
